user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: navigation_flow - Verify Homepage Accessibility
proposed_scenarios.description: This foundational smoke test verifies that the primary entry point of the website, the homepage, loads correctly. Due to the complete absence of captured user interactions beyond initial navigation, this is the only verifiable scenario that can be generated based on the provided data.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Ensure the website's homepage is consistently accessible to all users, serving as the starting point for all other site interactions.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a new user, I want to successfully load the Docker Hub homepage so that I can begin exploring the service's offerings.

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage and verify that the page title is correct, confirming the page has loaded successfully.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page title contains 'Docker Hub Container Image Library'
detailed_steps.business_impact: Represents the first and most critical point of user contact. Failure at this step indicates a total site outage for the user.

expected_results: The user successfully navigates to and loads the homepage.
The page title is verified, indicating the correct page has been rendered.
The system handles the initial page load without any client-side errors.
edge_cases_to_test: How the page loads on a slow network connection.
Page behavior when loaded with browser cache disabled.
Responsiveness of the homepage on various screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
data_requirements: No specific user data is required for this scenario.
prerequisites: The website URL is publicly accessible.
The test environment has a stable internet connection.
